description: Enhances skin in a portrait, tuned for portrait skin (Magnific Skin Enhancer).

dispatch_mode.description: Dispatch mode. "sync" (default) blocks until the job completes. "async" submits the job and returns immediately with a job ID; poll completion via `job_get`. Named `dispatch_mode` (not bare `mode`) so it never collides with provider-specific `mode` knobs (freepik DynamicCombo, pixverse motion mode, meshy pose mode, …).

mode.description: Processing mode (DynamicCombo parent). Determines the submit endpoint: creative→/skin-enhancer/creative, faithful→/skin-enhancer/faithful, flexible→/skin-enhancer/flexible.

optimized_for.description: Optimization target. Only honored when mode === 'flexible'.

skin_detail.description: Skin detail enhancement level. Only honored when mode === 'faithful' (node.py default: 80 if absent).
